summary: The summary-judgment burden case. The D.D.C. grants summary judgment to Celotex (and every other defendant) for want of evidence of exposure; the D.C. Circuit reverses; Celotex wins certiorari. Exercises the FRCP summary-judgment -> appeal route added for this case.

legs.context: Catrett sues fifteen asbestos manufacturers for her husband's wrongful death (D.D.C., filed September 1980); discovery has run.

steps.event: Celotex and twelve other defendants move for summary judgment: plaintiff has no evidence of exposure to their products
The court grants every motion from the bench (no written opinion)
With every defendant out, the judgment is final (28 U.S.C. § 1291)
Catrett appeals only the grant for Celotex (No. 83-1694)
The appeal crosses into the D.C. Circuit
Celotex, the appellee, considers a cross-appeal
The ruling was delivered from the bench, so a hearing transcript is ordered (route assumed)
Argued before Wald, Bork and Starr, JJ.
Summary judgment is a question of law (the opinion does not name the standard)
D.C. Circuit reverses and remands (Starr, J.; Bork, J., dissenting)
No rehearing petition in the sources read (route assumed)
Celotex petitions for certiorari (No. 85-198; filing date not found)
Certiorari granted, 474 U.S. 944, to resolve a conflict with the Third Circuit

gaps.event: Supreme Court reverses and remands (argued 1986-04-01, decided 1986-06-25): the movant need not negate the opponent's claim with its own evidence
gaps.why: No pack models Supreme Court merits review; cert-granted is terminal.

deadlines.trigger_event: the bench ruling granting summary judgment (the date the D.C. Circuit gives)
deadlines.arithmetic: FRAP 4(a)(1)(A): 30 days. Jul 21 + 10 = Jul 31; + 20 = Aug 20 (30), a Friday.
deadlines.historical: Not found. The rule runs from entry of the separate judgment, whose date was not found either, so this trigger is the ruling date.

deadlines.trigger_event: the D.C. Circuit's judgment, assuming no rehearing petition
deadlines.arithmetic: Sup. Ct. R. 13.1: 90 days. Mar 8 + 23 = Mar 31; + 30 = Apr 30 (53); + 31 = May 31 (84); + 6 = Jun 6 (90), a Thursday.

quirks: The FRCP pack's summary-judgment-granted node does not say who won; here the movant (Celotex) did.
The FRCP pack models one lawsuit with one defendant; the real judgment disposed of thirteen summary-judgment motions and two personal-jurisdiction dismissals together.

sources.title: Catrett v. Johns-Manville Sales Corp., 756 F.2d 181 (D.C. Cir. 1985)
